arg.name: robot_path
arg.description: Path to the robot USD file (absolute or relative).

arg.name: robot_prim
arg.description: Prim path where the robot USD will be referenced.

arg.name: namespace
arg.description: ROS 2 namespace for teleop and cmd_vel (a300, do100, or j100).

arg.name: isaac_python
arg.description: Path to Isaac Sim Python launcher.

executable.cmd: $(var isaac_python) $(find-pkg-share clearpath_isaac)/scripts/run_robot.py --robot-path $(var robot_path) --robot-prim $(var robot_prim) --spawn-z $(var spawn_z) --headless $(var headless)
